correctness.rationale: Exact stationary Lindblad resolvent r∫exp(−rt)e^(tL)(|00><00|)dt gives positive trace-one X matrix with rational entries A,B_a,B_b,S_a,S_b. A no-reset timewise nonnegative identity (1−e^(−4at))(1−e^(−4bt))+4e^(−2(a+b)t)sin²(2Jt) and Cauchy–Schwarz rule out the competing PPT branch for the stationary mixture. The remaining branch equals −P(r) divided by positive (r+2a+2b)² d_a d_b; symbolic independent exact simplification checked this identity. For J²≤ab, polynomial coefficients nonnegative and constant positive; for J²>ab, descending coefficient signs have exactly one variation and P(0)>0>P(∞), so exactly one positive root. Expanding offdiagonal J/r and single-bit-flip populations a/r,b/r yields concurrence asymptotic. Independent symbolic checks and several four-parameter numerical root counts corroborated; mathematical argument covers all positive parameters.
